mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by PAYEMS above 129,000 thousand persons, drives consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, compressing equity risk premiums and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between PAYEMS and 20-day forward returns is negative in more than 50% of 3-year rolling windows, or the correlation coefficient falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) signal accommodative monetary policy that reduces capital costs and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 9.5%) indicates a strong labor market under accommodative policy, accelerating economic growth and equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong labor market
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the joint condition against 20-day forward returns is below 0.03, or the positive return rate in triggered periods is less than 55%.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, GDPC1 exceeding 16,000 billion chained 2017 dollars signals robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for GDPC1 against 60-day forward returns is negative in more than 50% of 3-year rolling windows, or the return rate in recovery phases is not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE above 10.0%) indicates weak labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, which increases equity risk premiums and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or the Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO above 100) indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day forward returns is negative in more than 50% of 3-year rolling windows, or the correlation coefficient is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST above 600 thousand units) signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL above 220), elevated price pressures prompt central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and equity discount rates, which depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, or the Rank IC is above -0.03 over any 2-year window.
